scope: Three HA cards, synthetic local registry/history only; no ESP32 or real HA connection

results.name: Three registered card types load and discover the same synthetic device
Standby, flushing and real zero retain accurate output semantics
UV fault, disabled UV and unavailable or missing readings stay explicit
Filter reminders distinguish due, within limits, disabled, unknown and unregistered
More-info and keyboard circuit details open read-only UI and return focus
Selected-card hide overrides, motion preferences and theme do not affect sibling cards
Preview language and editor override affect each card independently
Visual editor manual mappings, draft preservation, custom filters and config round-trip
Preview history modes expose recorded gaps, empty history and errors honestly
Exact registry identity, explicit overrides, hidden and ambiguous entities
Stale registry responses cannot overwrite a newer manual configuration
Registry permission errors preserve mapped readings and retry can recover
Disconnect, reconnect and reattachment refresh registry without leaked listeners
Unavailable phase hides retained values on small/medium cards and unknown enums stay raw
Invalid numeric states, literal zero and untrusted text cannot create markup
Automatic filter slots hide not-fitted while explicit lists and stage mappings remain authoritative
History requests are read-only, bounded to selected entity and configured window
History opt-out and small layout never call the API even with show_history true
Pending history is deduplicated, and stale results cannot replace a new entity
Removing or disconnecting the card prevents further history polling
History gap/invalid/empty responses and latest unavailable data do not fabricate continuity
User links use safe URLs and native more-info without sending control services
Editor refreshes registry names after reattachment and module public APIs work
No uncaught browser exceptions, service writes or non-local network requests
